patch_description: Key parameters in the current program: single hex-row seed (4-5-4-5-4-4), Gauss-Seidel water-fill radii, no center refinement, no exact LP. The new version: (1) multiple diverse seeds (hex rows, corner-anchored layouts, wider staggered rows), (2) constraint-repulsion refinement (step decaying from 0.02 to 0.0005 over 300 iters, radii re-solved every 15 iters) to move centers away from walls/overlaps, (3) exact scipy LP radii when available for the best refined layout, with Gauss-Seidel fallback, (4) a shrink-only feasibility repair and try/except fallback guaranteeing a valid ≥2.45 result regardless of internal errors.
